question: Is terminal production-hook proof plus focused regression coverage sufficient to land this compaction fallback filter, or should maintainers require a live two-agent compaction recovery proof first?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but it changes a session-state/message-delivery recovery boundary where green CI cannot prove every timing-dependent live delivery shape.

options.title: Accept terminal hook proof
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the proof exercises the production compaction safeguard hook and regression-tests replay removal plus safe-text preservation.

options.title: Require live two-agent proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a real two-agent compaction recovery run shows one delivered reply and preserved safe source context.

options.title: Pause for broader boundary review
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want replay safety classified at a broader side-effect, transcript, or API boundary instead of filtering recovered fallback messages locally.

recommendation.title: Accept terminal hook proof
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the proof exercises the production compaction safeguard hook and regression-tests replay removal plus safe-text preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest sampled history across the compaction safeguard, sessions_send, and inter-session provenance surfaces involved in this boundary choice.
